The payment team's reconciliation tool at /app/ledger/ imports daily CSV exports from two payment providers into a SQLite ledger at /data/ledger.db and prints a per-merchant balance report. Finance has flagged that some merchant totals are wrong — off by a few cents or more — while others look fine. The exports are stored under /data/exports/.

Fix the tool so that running `python -m ledger report /data/exports` prints correct per-merchant balances to the cent. Refunds must always offset the specific charge they reference, not an arbitrary charge of the same amount. Running the import twice must produce the same report as running it once (idempotent).
